---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement for sumpter
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

<!--
Sumpter is in alpha — we welcome feature ideas, and contributions are welcome
too (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Because the surface is still moving, opening an issue
to discuss the design before writing code is the fastest path to influence the
roadmap and avoid colliding with in-flight work.
-->

## Problem / use case

<!--
What are you trying to accomplish? What's the underlying need or workflow
that current sumpter doesn't cover well? Concrete examples (input shape,
expected output, target environment) are much more useful than abstract
asks.
-->

## Proposed solution

<!--
Sketch what you'd like sumpter to do. CLI surface, configuration, recipe
syntax — whatever level you have ideas about. It's fine to leave some of
this open for maintainer input.
-->

## Alternatives considered

<!--
Other tools you've evaluated, workarounds you've tried, or alternative
designs you considered and rejected. Helps us understand the design space.
-->

## Scope / non-goals

<!--
Anything specifically out of scope for this request? Useful to keep
discussion focused.
-->

## Additional context

<!--
- Related issues or briefs?
- Public-data examples (ClinVar, SEC EDGAR XBRL, similar) that would
  exercise the new feature?
- Links to upstream prior art (other CLIs that have a similar feature)?
-->
